title: Coconut Quinoa Porridge
blurb: A gently sweetened breakfast porridge made with quinoa, coconut water and almond milk, finished with honey and vanilla.
steps: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly under cold running water in a fine mesh sieve until the water runs clear.
Put the quinoa, coconut water, almond milk and salt in a large saucepan and bring to the boil over a medium-high heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid and simmer gently for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the quinoa is tender and has absorbed most of the liquid.
Remove from the heat and stir in the honey and vanilla extract.
Let the porridge stand for 5 minutes to thicken slightly before serving.
